name: Kthini-qua
body:
Endemic to wet subterranean caverns, the kthini-qua are a sinister species of fishpeople known for conducting raids on the surface world for meat, supplies, and slaves.

Physical

Kthini-qua are cold, albino fish-people with the characteristics of both cave fish and piranhas. They are colorless or even slightly translucent—a quality that can actually give them an almost imperceptible glint of color depending on the light, making them look silver, pink, purple, green, or black.

They have large, bulging eyes that provide them with excellent darkvision but leave them blinded in bright light. Their wide mouths are full of teeth that are covered in vicious serration.

Kthini-qua have bloated bodies and thin limbs that bely their strength. Their arms and legs end in wide, webbed hands and feet; they walk with an awkward shuffling gait on land, but they are skilled swimmers.

Social

Kthini-qua are strictly carnivorous and raid the surface frequently to obtain the large quantities of meat that they require. They are not shy about eating sapient species, but usually prefer to capture these beings as slaves if the opportunity presents itself. They may trade slaves to drow or duergar for supplies, or they may keep the slaves and use them to perform manual labor and tend to livestock such as cave lizards. Unlike the kthini-qua themselves, their slaves are fed strictly on subterranean crops like mushrooms; many unaccustomed to such fare quickly grow sickly and weak from such a diet.

Alignment And Religion

The kthini-qua are a bitter, wicked, and selfcentered people. They do not place any value in honor or compassion, and wantonly take what they are able. Kthini-qua thus tends to be Chaotic Evil. Most communities worship a patron demon lord, although some favor more traditional aquatic deities.

Core Traits
Ability Score Modifiers You are sturdy and perceptive but off-putting. Your ability score modifiers are +2 Con, +2 Wis, –2 Cha [standard]. (0)
Size As a Medium creature, you have no bonuses or penalties due to size. (0)
Type You are an Aberration with the aquatic subtype. (3)
Speed Your base speed is 20 feet. Your speed is never reduced by armor or encumbrance. (–1)
Languages You begin play speaking Aklo and Undercommon. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Aboleth, Aquan, Common, Dwarven, and Elven. (0)
Other Traits
Amphibious You can breathe both air and water. (2)
Bite You have a bite attack. This is a primary natural attack that deals 1d4 damage. (2)
Darkvision You have darkvision with a range of 120 feet. (1)
Light Blindness Abrupt exposure to bright light (such as sunlight or a daylight spell) blinds you for 1 round. On subsequent rounds, you are dazzled as long as you remain in the affected area, causing you to take a –1 penalty on attack rolls and on visual Perception checks. (–2)
Powerful Swimmer You have a swim speed of 40 feet and gain the +8 species bonus on Swim checks that a swim speed normally grants. (3)
Resistant You have cold resistance 5, and you gain a +4 species bonus to saving throws against paralysis and poison. (2)
Slippery You secrete an oily substance that makes you difficult to ensnare. You gain a +2 species bonus to Escape Artist checks, a +2 species bonus to your CMD to resist grapple attempts, and a +2 bonus to saving throws against any spell or other effect that imposes the entangled condition. (4)
Weapon Familiarity Kthini-qua receive special training in nonlethal ways of capturing foes. You are proficient with mancatchers and nets. (1)
Total: 15 RP (advanced)
Alternate Traits
Blind Fully accustomed to the lightless depths, you have lost the use of your eyes. However, this has awakened your other senses, giving you blindsight with a range of 60 feet. You cannot see purely visual phenomena, but are unaffected by sight-based illusions or gaze effects. This trait replaces darkvision and light blindness.
Blood Frenzy Your bite has a critical hit range of 19–20/×2, and on a critical hit, it also inflicts 1 point of bleed damage. You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls against any foe who is currently taking bleed damage. This trait replaces resistant.
Immobilizer You are less concerned with keeping your opponents alive than you are with simply shutting them down. You are proficient with the claw-flail* and the ogre hook UE. This trait replaces weapon familiarity.
Natural Armor Your scaly skin provides you with a +1 natural armor bonus to AC. This trait replaces resistant.
Slaver You are one of the ruthless kthiniqua who have been tasked with overseeing the captured slaves and keeping them from escaping. You are proficient with the whip and the bolas. This trait replaces weapon familiarity.
Sticky Instead of making you slippery, the oil you secrete acts as an adhesive. You gain a +2 species bonus to your CMB on grapple attempt. In addition, a number of times per day equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1/day), you can apply this adhesive to a weapon that you wield as a swift action, or you can apply the adhesive directly to an opponent with a successful ? melee touch attack. Applying the adhesive to a weapon gives that weapon the grapple special weapon quality for 1 minute (10 rounds). Applying the adhesive directly to an opponent gives that opponent the entangled condition for 2d4 rounds; a successful Reflex saving throw reduces the duration to 1 round (DC 10 + 1/2 your Hit Dice + your Constitution modifier). This trait replaces slippery.
Favored Class Bonuses
Alchemist Add +1/2 to the number of bombs per day you can create.
Barbarian Add +1/2 on critical hit confirmation rolls for attacks made with unarmed strikes or natural weapons (maximum bonus of +4). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Cleric Select one domain power granted at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier. Add +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that domain power.
Druid Gain energy resistance 1 against acid, cold, electricity, or fire. Each time you select this reward, increase your resistance to one of these energy types by +1 (maximum 10 for any one type).
Fighter Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a disarm or grapple attempt.
Inquisitor Add +1/6 to the number of times per day you can use the judgment class feature.
Kineticist Add +1/3 point of damage to water element blasts that deal damage.
Mesmerist Increase your towering ego bonus by +1/3 point (to a maximum increase of +2).
Monk Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a grapple or trip attempt.
Psychic Treat your Charisma bonus as +1/3 point higher for the purpose of determining the number of uses or rounds per day of your discipline powers.
Ranger Choose a weapon from the following list: bite, bolas, claw-flail*, mancatcher, ogre hook UE, or whip. Add +1/2 on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using that weapon (maximum bonus of +4). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Rogue Add a +1/2 bonus on Bluff checks to feint and a +1/2 bonus on Stealth checks made in dim light or darkness.
Shaman Add +5 feet to the range of a chosen shaman hex. Multiple bonuses from this ability can apply to the same hex, to a maximum of an additional 30 feet for any single hex.
Slayer Increase the studied target bonus on Perception and Survival checks by +1/4. When you gain the stalker class feature, you also gain this increase to your studied target bonus on Stealth checks.
Witch Add +1 spell from the witch spell list to your familiar. This spell must be at least one spell level lower than the highest-level witch spell you can cast. If you ever replace your familiar, the new familiar knows these bonus spells.
